questions.stem_text:
Mules are relatively long-lived and hardy organisms that cannot, generally speaking,
perform successful meiosis. Consequently, which statement about mules is true?

options.B: They can produce viable gametes through mitosis.
options.C: They have a relative evolutionary fitness of zero.
options.D: Their offspring are always genetically identical to the parents.
options.E: They cannot produce offspring due to lack of genetic variation.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - They have a relative evolutionary fitness of zero.

questions.stem_text:
A chemical agent is found to denature all enzymes in the synaptic cleft. What effect will
this agent have on acetylcholine?

options.A: Acetylcholine will not be degraded in the synaptic cleft.
options.B: Acetylcholine will not bind to receptor proteins on the postsynaptic membrane.
options.C: Acetylcholine will not be produced in the presynaptic membrane.
options.D: Acetylcholine will be excessively produced in the synaptic cleft.
options.E: Acetylcholine will not be transported to the synaptic cleft.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Acetylcholine will not be degraded in the synaptic cleft.

questions.stem_text:
In acommensalisticrelationship between two species living symbioticallywhat are the
consequences of their interactions?

options.B: One species benefits, and the other is significantly harmed
options.C: One species harms the other without any benefit
options.E: The species exchange benefits, but one benefits more than the other

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Both species benefit equally

Does confined placental mosaicism account for adverse perinatal outcomes in IVF pregnancies?
questions.answer_explanation: The incidence of CPM is not increased in IVF/ICSI pregnancies compared with spontaneous conceptions. CPM probably does not account for the adverse perinatal outcomes following IVF/ICSI.

questions.stem_text: Does patient position during liver surgery influence the risk of venous air embolism?
questions.answer_explanation: The effect on venous pressures caused by the change in patient positioning alone during liver surgery does not affect the risk of venous air embolism.

questions.stem_text: Post-tonsillectomy late haemorrhage: is it a preferably night-time event?
questions.answer_explanation: The incidence of post-tonsillectomy late haemorrhage in our study population was 1.78%. A statistically significant difference was found between night-time and day-time haemorrhages. Even though no significant distribution of haemorrhages per hour was observed, we underline that we recorded 32 (54.2%) events in 2 periods of the day: from 10 p.m. to 1 a.m. and from 6 to 9 a.m.

questions.stem_text: Do patients with rheumatoid arthritis established on methotrexate and folic acid 5 mg daily need to continue folic acid supplements long term?
questions.answer_explanation: It is important to continue FA supplementation over the long term in patients on methotrexate and FA in order to prevent them discontinuing treatment because of mouth ulcers or nausea and vomiting. Our data suggest that FA supplementation is also helpful in preventing neutropenia, with very little loss of efficacy of methotrexate.

questions.stem_text: Prognostic factors for cervical spondylotic amyotrophy: are signs of spinal cord involvement associated with the neurological prognosis?
questions.answer_explanation: The presence of a high signal intensity change on T 2-weighted MRI and the pyramidal tract sign can be used as prognostic factors for patients with CSA.
